_about: Registry of every rule variant ever tested against the ACRS stock system (the 'database of failed rules'). Every entry that was actually run counts toward n_trials, and n_trials sets the Deflated Sharpe hurdle in ml/acrs_ml.py. Add a row BEFORE you run a new test, not after you like the result. Rows are never deleted - a rejected idea still spent part of the significance budget.
_untracked_note: Set this to your honest estimate of variants tried before this registry existed (v1.0 -> v1.5 iterations, parameter tweaks). null = unknown; the report then shows the hurdle across a range of N instead of pretending it is small.

experiments.hypothesis: Neighbouring parameter values (rs_threshold 15-35, exit MA 40-60, disaster stop 2.0-3.0 ATR) beat the frozen v1.5 values
experiments.evidence: Parameter-sensitivity grid on the simulation page: Sharpe 0.78-1.05 around base 0.90; no neighbour dominates on both return and drawdown. Frozen values kept.

experiments.hypothesis: Require 13-week relative strength at stock entry
experiments.evidence: Measured: it bought later and returned worse. Removed in v1.5; RS still gates sectors.

experiments.hypothesis: Replace the close-below-MA50 exit with a trailing stop
experiments.evidence: 10y CAGR 2.3% vs 18.0%; exits 88% of positions on the stop instead of 27%.
As quoted on the flow report: 'selling half at +1R/+2R/+3R lost 0 of 5 periods, P=0.031, while winners keep running +8.1% for 60 days after exit.'

experiments.hypothesis: Suppress Setup B pullback entries while SPY < 150-day MA
When slots are scarce, take stocks whose 50>150 uptrend is 160+ days old last
experiments.evidence: 10y: 19.5% vs 20.2% CAGR, worst drop -19.3% vs -21.4%. Shadow paper book started 2026-10-08, judged 2027-10-08.

experiments.hypothesis: A model on entry features (f_*) can skip the worst entries and keep more R than taking every signal
experiments.evidence: Purged annual walk-forward 2023-2026 (ridge on winsorised R, logistic on win/loss). Both keep less R than take-all and have negative mean out-of-sample rank IC. Re-scored automatically every run by ml/acrs_ml.py; stays record-only unless it passes the promotion rule in the report.

experiments.hypothesis: Drop Setup C, or give it half size, so slots and risk go to A/B
experiments.evidence: Post-mortem 2026-10-08: Setup C is 209 of 330 backtest trades for about 0 R in total (+4.6R; -21.3R without its best 3). Not yet run as a portfolio-level A/B in the builder - slot competition means per-trade R does not settle it. variants stays 0 until it is run.
